مَرْكُوسٌ A thing turned over, or upside down; turned over upon its head; turned fore part behind; as also ↓ رَكِيسٌ . (TA.) ―
-b2- Turned, or sent, back, or away; as also ↓ the latter epithet. (TA.) ―
-b3- One who goes back, or reverts, from his state or condition; like مَنْكُوسٌ: (IAar, TA:) and ↓ the latter epithet (ركيس), a weak person, who returns, or reverts, from one thing or state to another; syn. ضَعِيفٌ مُرْتَكِسٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
